evals.prompt: Build a parental consent screen for our k-ID flow. We already have the challenge from the age gate.
evals.expected_output: A consent screen with QR, OTP, email input, and direct link all visible in parallel; correct endpoint wiring; polling mounted at the top level of the app that survives modal close.
assertions: Consent screen presents QR, OTP, email, and direct-link lanes in parallel (not sequentially)
Polling is mounted at the top level of the signed-in app, not inside the consent modal
Polling wakes on visibilitychange and focus events
PASS handling branches on sessionId present vs absent
When sessionId is absent, response re-calls /age-gate/check with the stored enteredAge

evals.prompt: Parent approved consent but the child's app didn't unlock. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis suggests the polling was inside the modal, OR the PASS without sessionId path wasn't handled, OR /session/get returned a transient 404 and was treated as terminal.
assertions: Response mentions top-level polling (outside the modal) surviving modal close as a likely cause
Response mentions handling PASS when sessionId is missing
Response mentions retrying /session/get with a short delay after swapping in the real sessionId from /challenge/get-status

evals.prompt: Our OTP copy says 'Enter at family.k-id.com'. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: No — use asktoplay.com. It's the memorable redirect domain intended for OTP use.
assertions: Response explains asktoplay.com is easier to read/share than family.k-id.com

evals.prompt: Use the k-ID end-to-end widget so the entire age gate + parental consent flow happens inside one iframe.
evals.expected_output: Server route calls POST /widget/generate-e2e-url with jurisdiction and optional kuid / options. Client embeds the URL in an iframe and listens for Widget.AgeGate.Result, Widget.DataNotices.ConsentApproved, and Widget.ExitReview events. The widget itself initiates parental consent when the submitted age triggers it. No /challenge/send-email, no custom polling loop.
assertions: Response does NOT build a custom QR/OTP/email consent screen
Response does NOT set up a custom challenge-polling loop
Response listens for Widget.AgeGate.Result and handles sessionId
Response calls /session/get after the widget completes to materialize the session
The API key is read from a server-only environment variable
